name: Motion Reel
tagline: Turn an idea into a looping motion-design reel: generative scenes cut on the beat, bold transitions, all drawn in code.
whatYouGet: A 20–40 second reel cut on the beat that loops without a seam, with a soundtrack made for it
Scenes cast from the idea out of 21: 3D point clouds of any object, type built from cells, fractures, fractal dives, halftone, particles, ribbons, glitch and kinetic type, a rewind
Bold joins: zoom through a dot, punch, whip pan, shatter, slices, spin, ink flood, pixelate
MP4 in 9:16, plus 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9, and a page that plays it on a loop
goodFit: Abstract ideas, beliefs and principles told in motion
Striking loops for a talk, a podcast episode, a course or a launch teaser
notFor: Footage, photos or screenshots of your product
youBring: An idea, and a name for the end card
Your own track, if you'd rather not use the generated one
needs: Google Chrome or Edge (or Playwright's Chromium)

network.purpose: playwright-core for the renderer, installed once
